newsitem.title: USA: MTS sees $0.27/shr Q3 gain from land sale.
newsitem.headline: MTS sees $0.27/shr Q3 gain from land sale.

text.p: MTS Systems Corp, a maker of computer-based testing and simulation systems, said Thursday it expects to report a $0.27 a share gain in the third quarter ended June 30 from the sale of land.
The company reported earnings of $0.30 a share for the fiscal 1996 third quarter.
The company said it sold the undeveloped land south of its headquarters May 28 to an undisclosed buyer.
Also, construction has begun on a 43,000 square foot addition to its corporate headquarters and manufacturing facility, the company said.

"The building addition will be used for warehousing and manufacturing-related operations," Howell Owens, MTS vice president, said in a news release. "It will include a new logistics center and will provide expanded manufacturing operations for our primary product lines."
MTS said it expects the addition will be ready for use in early October of this year, resulting in a total facility exceeding 400,000 square feet.
